Fixes automatic theme selection during install and uninstall.

### Fixed

- **Installer could not switch the GUI to UniSense** on OPNsense 25.7–26.7 (`Call to undefined function shell_safe()`). The theme helper now saves the setting through OPNsense's configuration API, the same way core's own scripts do, and records a normal configuration revision and backup.
- Uninstall had the same problem when switching back to the stock theme.
- The one-line installer failed with "the downloaded archive does not contain UniSense" while no release was published, and `GITHUB_TOKEN` installs failed with HTTP 415.
- When something cannot be done automatically, the installer now says what to do next and shows the error.

### Update

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```

### Testing

The theme helper, model migration, Network Map model validation and uninstall now run for real against OPNsense core 25.7, 26.1 and 26.7 in CI (PHP with Phalcon), not only syntax-checked.
